# Hetvi Makwana

> Mumbai-based Gujarati comedy creator (@hetvimakwanaa) known for desi relatable POV skits: the deflation (full hype to deadpan in one beat), the held stare and the break (laughing at herself). Managed by @cretoro_.

## Facts (as of 7 Nov 2026)
- Followers: 62,594
- Likes on her own posts: 10,655,631
- Biggest reel: "Dating in 2026 be like", 1,258,145 likes
- Reels past 100,000 likes: 26
- On Instagram since: at least April 2022 (her earliest reel in the material)
- Brands she has made reels with: McDonald's India, Dove, Maybelline, Parachute Advansed, Fudge It, Saffola, Lifelong, TressTales, Funcity, Freakins, Lancôme, Damroo, DotShot, Jovees Herbal, Campus Shoes, Hairstylist Garima Salon
